description: Unofficial fan art of Japan (Kiku Honda) from Hetalia. A fully clothed companion folding and carefully repairing a paper crane, brushing a miniature bonsai, aligning a teacup tray, waiting politely, making a small cushioned hop, and running with compact articulated steps. Neutral simplified white outfit without real-world propaganda symbols. Original animation choreography; no official affiliation.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
